children: IndiGo also received awards for Best Cabin Crew in India & South Asia and Cleanest Airline in India & South Asia

IndiGo has been named the Best Low-Cost Airline in India & South Asia at the 2026 World Airline Awards by Skytrax, marking the airline’s 16th recognition as the best low-cost airline across regional categories including India, Central Asia and South Asia.

IndiGo also received awards for Best Cabin Crew in India & South Asia and Cleanest Airline in India & South Asia. The airline said the recognition reflects its focus on operational excellence and affordable, on-time travel.

Since its launch in 2006, IndiGo has flown nearly 900 million customers and currently carries more than one million customers every three days. The airline operates across its domestic network and more than 40 international destinations across Asia, the Middle East, Africa and Europe.

Willie Walsh, Chief Executive Officer, IndiGo, said, “Being recognised as the Best Low-Cost Airline for the 16th time by Skytrax, in IndiGo’s journey of 20 years so far, reflects our relentless focus on operational excellence and hassle-free experiences. It is also a testament to the enduring trust and confidence our customers have consistently placed in us over the last two decades and we thank them for their continued patronage and support. This recognition belongs to our committed workforce, whose unwavering dedication, passion, and professionalism bring our brand promise to life every day and make achievements like these possible. We are grateful to Skytrax for recognizing our efforts and inspiring us to continue our pursuit of excellence.”

The World Airline Awards are based on Skytrax’s annual passenger satisfaction survey, conducted from September 2025 to August 2026, with 24.8 million eligible entries from customers across more than 100 nationalities and over 300 airlines.
